fields.postcondition: Every supported ShardKeyType primitive round-trips through GetValueBytes/WriteBufferValueBytes and TryConvertFromBytes, and truncated buffers are rejected cleanly by returning false without throwing out-of-range exceptions or advancing the cursor.
fields.response: GetValueBytes and WriteBufferValueBytes serialize all 18 supported ShardKeyType primitives — Guid, int, long, byte, short, char, decimal, double, float, DateTime, DateOnly (serialized as a 4-byte DayNumber), TimeOnly (serialized as an 8-byte Ticks value), TimeSpan, DateTimeOffset, Half, Int128, UInt128, string (length-and-flag-byte prefixed up to 127 UTF-8 bytes), and enum types (dispatched via their underlying integer type) — into their binary representations. TryConvertFromBytes validates remaining span lengths ahead of the cursor before reading any supported type (including fixed-width primitives, Guid, decimal, DateOnly, TimeOnly, byte, string, byte[], Memory<byte>, ReadOnlyMemory<byte>, and enum types): when the buffer has fewer bytes remaining than required by the target type or its length prefix, or when valueType is not a supported type, TryConvertFromBytes returns false, sets result to default, and leaves pos unchanged; only on a successful read does it assign the decoded value to result, advance pos by the consumed byte count, and return true.
fields.subject: Shard Key Serialization
fields.trigger: ShardKeySerialization: a caller reads a key-column value from a byte span at a cursor position via TryConvertFromBytes, supplying the .NET type expected for that column, or writes one via GetValueBytes or WriteBufferValueBytes
